title: Native coefficient reduction and whole-system counit before support
statement: Fix ell,E,W, the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and its native quotient coefficient sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Restrict sequence modules to completed module towers and then along the canonical constant-to-completed map, giving systemRestriction and its exact localization systemU. The rings of the target towers are the constant integral ring sheaves. For a recorded calculus S [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], define reduction=S.reduction followed by systemU. Define ordinaryLimit as completed coefficient sequence restriction followed by ordinary limit; ordinaryReduction is its left adjoint, ordinaryReductionAdj its canonical adjunction. Define reductionRightComparison as the unique natural isomorphism from the right derived ordinaryLimit to coefficientSequenceLimit commuting with all cochain derived units [def-pur-whole-cochain-derived-unit]. Define systemReductionCounit as the adjunction mate of ordinaryLimit.rightDerivedFunctorUnit under the ordinary reduction/limit adjunction and the S reduction/limit adjunction transported through reductionRightComparison. Exactness and additivity of the restriction and additive adjunction data are retained. None of these definitions involves geometric pushforward, extension by zero, compactification, or any scalar balancing comparison.
